lines.speaker: Mr. Chen
lines.text: You didn't force it. You watched, adjusted, tested. That's real repair.

lines.speaker: Mr. Chen
lines.text: Garage smells like chain grease again. Means somebody did honest work.

lines.speaker: Mr. Chen
lines.text: Now bring those same careful eyes back outside. I want to show you why bridge builders trust triangles.

lines.speaker: Mr. Chen
lines.text: Meet me by the bridge review station in the neighborhood, and we'll trace where the weight goes.
